Subject: Vendor onboarding: legal entity details & PO routing for Atlas Foundry

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the upcoming integration. To complete the vendor master in our ERP and ensure smooth PO/payment flow, can you please confirm the following items and attach the supporting docs? If you prefer, you can reply with the files or upload to the Drive link below.

Requested fields (we need these to create the Vendor Master record):
- Legal entity name exactly as registered
- DBA (if any)
- Legal address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Tax ID / VAT number (specify jurisdiction)
- Registered signatory name and title for contracts
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone)
- Preferred PO ingestion method: (a) email to bills@redwood.com, (b) vendor portal upload, or (c) EDI integration — which is your preference?
- Bank remit instructions (if you want to set up ACH/wire) or confirm payment team will accept our standard invoice process

Attachments we need: W9 (or local equivalent), proof of address, sample invoice. I attached our PO routing template to show where we store the PO number / remit details.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAtlasOnboard

If you can send these by EOD Thursday 6/17 that would help us get the first PO out the door next week.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
